description: Core and gluteal activation to support lumbar stability and relieve lower back pain.
steps:
1. Lie on back with knees bent and feet flat on floor hip-width apart.
2. Engage abdominal core gently.
3. Lift hips upward until knees, hips and shoulders form a straight line.
4. Hold for 5 seconds, lower down slowly.
5. Repeat 10-12 repetitions.
precautions: Avoid hyperextending lower back at the top of the bridge.
avoid_if: Severe acute spinal instability, unmanaged severe hernia.

description: Relieves tension headaches and strengthens deep cervical neck flexors.
steps:
1. Sit upright with shoulders relaxed.
2. Look straight ahead, gently glide chin straight back (as if making a subtle double chin).
3. Hold for 5 seconds without tilting head up or down.
4. Relax and repeat 10 times.
precautions: Movement should be pain-free and smooth.
avoid_if: Acute cervical spine fracture or severe dizziness upon movement.

exercise_name: Isometric Quadriceps Sets & Straight Leg Raises
description: Strengthens thigh muscles to stabilize knee joint and reduce knee arthritis pain.
steps:
1. Lie on back with one leg straight and the other knee bent.
2. Tighten thigh muscle of straight leg pushing back of knee into bed.
3. Lift straight leg 12 inches off surface.
4. Hold 5 seconds, slowly lower.
5. Perform 10 reps per leg.
precautions: Do not hold breath while lifting leg.
avoid_if: Acute severe knee effusion / acute ligament tear.

exercise_name: Gentle Active Hand & Finger Range of Motion
description: Preserves joint mobility and decreases morning hand stiffness in arthritis.
steps:
1. Sit comfortably with arms supported on table.
2. Slowly open fingers wide, then gently curl fingers into a soft loose fist.
3. Touch thumb to tip of each finger sequentially.
4. Perform 10 gentle repetitions.
precautions: Never force movement into sharp joint pain.
